item.content:encoded: I won't call attention to the wham lines in this article (of which there are many!) but I will say that the storytelling here is on point. No single story beat slowed down the pace of this. Also, Percival Darke (a character who I don't think I've really read about before) reads like a sinister Victorian vampire and I love that a lot.

Zealot, would you please be a dear and come into the office at your earliest convenience? Great Grandsire and I would like to discuss this issue in person.

At this point I actually said "Oooh…" out loud.
Hopefully they didn't traumatize/maim Zealot too badly- I like this guy's snarky biopunk heresy.

Also, speaking as an artist:

This sucks! I was making this huge project of 3D digital anart.

this is one of the most dangerous complaints on the list. I have experienced this feeling myself; "White-hot screaming fury tempering to an icy rage" comes close to describing it. I have a strict policy of making myself wait an hour or two before filing bug reports for this sort of incident, as the first draft generally requires editing.
